memory_artifact_path.principle: Durable verifier-memory ledger written for reuse by later experiments.

memory_entries_written.principle: Count of idempotently deduplicated memory entries in the durable ledger.

promotions.principle: Entries promoted to reusable verifier memory after deterministic guards and held-out gate passed.

rollbacks.principle: Entries rolled back or blocked because deterministic guards or held-out usefulness evidence were insufficient.

deterministic_guardrails_enforced.principle: Promotion policy requires deterministic guardrail status before any memory promotion.

heldout_gate_required_for_promotion.principle: Promotion policy requires useful held-out delta; null, zero, negative, or missing held-out evidence rolls back.

tests_run.principle: Commands executed while building Exp 5214, with pass/fail status.

value.note: Expected red test before this result artifact existed; failed on FileNotFoundError for results/experiment_5214_continuous_self_learning_verifier_memory_v477.json.

inference_substrate.principle: Declares that Exp 5214 builds verifier memory from prior deterministic artifacts rather than new model inference.

source_artifacts.principle: Upstream evidence used to populate the memory entries without copying raw candidate rows or test labels.

memory_summary.principle: Separates promoted memory from rollback records so later experiments can reuse positives and avoid null candidates.

honest_verdict.principle: Must start with complete:/complete_/success:/success_ and report promotions and rollbacks separately.
